name: Sorbara Lambrusco Rosé
serverNotes:
📖 ABOUT: (cantinedisorbara.it) Lambrusco Rosé from Sorbara - lightly sparkling Italian rosé! Fun, refreshing, low alcohol. Perfect summer wine!

🍷 STYLE: Light-bodied, frizzante | Strawberry, raspberry & floral | Lightly sparkling | Low alcohol, refreshing.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Charcuterie, pizza, appetizers, summer dishes.

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: Fun sparkling rosé! Light, refreshing, perfect for groups!

name: La Fiera Pinot Grigio
serverNotes:
📖 ABOUT: (lafiera.it) Pinot Grigio from La Fiera in Friuli. Serious northern Italian Pinot Grigio with depth. Not your typical PG!

🍷 STYLE: Medium-bodied Pinot Grigio | Pear, almond & minerality | Structured, complex | Friuli quality.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Seafood, white fish, risotto, Italian cuisine.

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: Quality Friuli Pinot Grigio. Step above standard PG!

name: Loosen Riesling
serverNotes:
📖 ABOUT: (drloosen.com) Mosel Riesling from legendary Dr. Loosen estate. Classic German Riesling with precision. World-renowned quality!

🍷 STYLE: Light to medium-bodied Riesling | Peach, citrus & slate minerality | Off-dry, balanced | Classic Mosel character.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Asian cuisine, spicy dishes, seafood, pork.

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: Legendary German Riesling. Classic Mosel quality!

name: Trimbach Riesling
serverNotes:
🏆 ABOUT: (maison-trimbach.fr) Riesling from historic Trimbach in Alsace, France. Family estate since 1626. Benchmark dry Riesling!

🍷 STYLE: Medium-bodied Riesling | Citrus, stone fruit & minerality | Bone dry, precise | Alsace elegance | Age-worthy.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Seafood, Asian cuisine, charcuterie, fine dining.

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: Historic Alsace Riesling. Benchmark dry style!

name: Guado Al Tasso, Vermentino
serverNotes:
🏆 ABOUT: (antinori.it) Guado al Tasso Vermentino from legendary Antinori in Tuscany. Coastal Tuscan white with elegance. Premium quality!

🍷 STYLE: Medium-bodied Vermentino | Citrus, white flowers & minerality | Fresh, elegant | Tuscan coastal character.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Seafood, grilled fish, Mediterranean cuisine.

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: Antinori's coastal Tuscan white. Premium Vermentino!

name: G.D. Vajra Rosabella Rosato
serverNotes:
🌿 ABOUT: (gdvajra.com) Rosa Bella rosé from biodynamic G.D. Vajra! Nebbiolo rosé from Piedmont. Organic, elegant, unique. Also available by the glass!

🍷 STYLE: Medium-bodied rosé | Strawberry, herbs & minerality | Elegant, dry | Nebbiolo character | Biodynamic quality.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Salads, seafood, Mediterranean cuisine, summer dishes.

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: Biodynamic Nebbiolo rosé! Unique Piedmont style. Available by the glass too!

name: Benanti Etna Bianco
serverNotes:
📖 ABOUT: (vinibenanti.it) Etna Bianco from Benanti on Mt. Etna, Sicily. Volcanic terroir with indigenous grapes. Unique Sicilian white!

🍷 STYLE: Medium-bodied white blend | Citrus, mineral & volcanic character | Fresh, distinctive | Mt. Etna terroir.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Seafood, grilled fish, Sicilian cuisine, Mediterranean dishes.

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: Volcanic Sicilian white. Unique Mt. Etna terroir!

name: Gianni Gagliardo Roero Arneis
serverNotes:
📖 ABOUT: (gagliardowine.com) Roero Arneis from Gianni Gagliardo in Piedmont. Indigenous Arneis grape. Classic Piedmont white!

🍷 STYLE: Medium-bodied Arneis | White flowers, pear & almond | Fresh, aromatic | Indigenous Piedmont grape.

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Seafood, risotto, white fish, Italian cuisine.

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: Indigenous Piedmont white. Arneis grape specialty!

name: Terra Alpina, Pinot Grigio
serverNotes:
📖 ABOUT: Alpine Pinot Grigio from Alois Lageder's Terra Alpina line in northern Italy (IGT). Grown at altitude for freshness.

🍷 STYLE: Light to medium-bodied Pinot Grigio | Pear, green apple, lemon & mountain herbs | Crisp, mineral | Dry, clean finish

🍽️ PAIRS WITH: Salads, shrimp scampi, calamari, burrata, light seafood, antipasto.

💡 BOTTLE SERVICE: A strong bottle to suggest for the table; check the vintage on the list when presenting.
